videos.title: College Football
videos.description: The No. 19 Ole Miss Rebels (6-3) visit the Oklahoma Sooners at Memorial Stadium in Norman for an SEC matchup. Ole Miss seek to rebound after a 42-7 loss to Georgia and rely on Trinidad Chambliss, while Oklahoma beat Florida 23-7 in Week 10.

videos.title: College Football
videos.description: The No. 17 Gamecocks (6-3, 4-3) ride a four-game win streak into their SEC road test against the Razorbacks (3-6, 1-5). Two of those were away wins by a combined 36 points. South Carolina quarterback LaNorris Sellers has accounted for 24 TDs in 2026.
